# Page 1
SCHEDULE B
(Form 1040) 2025 Interest and Ordinary Dividends
Header: Part I Interest
Header: (a) (b)
- 1: List name of payer
Header: Amount
- 2: Add the amounts on line 1
- 3: Excludable interest on series EE and I U.S. savings bonds
- 4: Subtract line 3 from line 2
Header: Part II Ordinary Dividends
Header: (a) (b) (c)
- 5: List name of payer
Header: Amount
- 6: Add the amounts on line 5
- 7: Ordinary dividends
- 8: Subtract line 7 from line 6
Header: Part III Foreign Accounts and Trusts
- 9: At any time during 2025, did you have a financial interest in or signature authority over a financial account in a foreign country
- 10: If you are required to file FinCEN Form 114, enter the name of the foreign country
